evidence.detail: The bot already has a custom emoji system that looks up guild custom emojis by name and replaces {W}, {U}, {B}, {R}, {G} etc. symbols at runtime
manamoji is not referenced anywhere in the codebase; the linked repo https://github.com/scryfall/manamoji-discord provides ready-made Discord emoji assets

triage.notes: Decision needed: (1) whether current guild-custom-emoji approach already works for mana symbols in the PD Discord server, and (2) if not, whether to use the manamoji bot/server, upload the assets as guild emojis, or use Discord's application-level emoji feature. Different answers lead to different implementation approaches.
